mostWorthwhile.text: The selected B cell multiplying and branching into plasma and memory cells was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects a single recognition event to both antibody production and a later response.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing helper T cells at the lymph node was a straightforward preparation with little to examine on its own.

surprise.text: The B cell bound an intact bacterial protein but displayed a fragment, linking its recognition to the helper T-cell response.

arbitrary.text: The lymph-node placement felt procedural, although its purpose was clear. The helper signals were left unspecified, which leaves a connection worth explaining for this audience.

continue.text: I would continue: the branching immune response and the qualification that antibody tagging does not eliminate every bacterium made me curious about what other defenses do next. The largely forced sequence offered few meaningful choices, though.
